# 3D Asset Auto

> Local-first 3D asset runtime: reference image → TRELLIS.2 → Blender → agent inspection → GLB. Generation provider is independent of editing: the agent chooses no rig, rigid object motion, a SkinTokens draft, custom Blender scripts or compatible clip merging. Tripo is explicitly selected only. Godot checks are project-dependent and interactive viewers require a user request.

## Install and operate

- [Install](INSTALL.md): Default TRELLIS/models/Blender installation, skill links, optional engine/viewer/MCP components and updates.
- [Quick start](QUICKSTART.md): Korean usage guide with generation, edits, asynchronous jobs and visual review.
- [Agent instructions](AGENTS.md): Repository commands, source contracts and maintenance invariants.
- [Asset skill](.agents/skills/3d-assets/SKILL.md): Workflow for creating and reviewing assets.
- [Request fields](.agents/skills/3d-assets/references/specs.md): Generation and edit specifications.
- [Runtime reference](.agents/skills/3d-assets/references/runtime.md): CLI commands and artifact layout.
- [Tripo option](docs/TRIPO.md): Explicit provider choice, private key setup, PNG/JPEG and multiview inputs, automatic standard generation with optional credit limit, and known-task recovery.
- [Character and part processing](docs/CHARACTERS.md): Default local rigging, motion, agent-prompted semantic parts, character imports and provider-aware recovery.
- [Blender editing and clips](docs/BLENDER.md): Trusted local scripts for object/custom motion, rig/weight/material changes, compatible clip merging, animation preservation and checkpoint recovery.
- [Usage and quality](docs/QUALITY.md): Purpose-based functional criteria, representation limits, playback contracts, optional final-GLB motion assessment, critical frames and scoped evidence.

## Understand and troubleshoot

- [Overview](README.md): Implemented scope, verified results and current limitations.
- [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md): Components, coordinate conventions, revisions and separate quality gates.
- [Troubleshooting](docs/TROUBLESHOOTING.md): Offline viewer, downloads, environment locks and interrupted jobs.

This file is a navigation aid, not an installer or a guarantee that every client automatically reads it. Install the shared checkout before linking its skill; add learned postprocessing models only when needed. Local presets accumulate clips, while authoring and compatible merging use Blender without extra inference models. Import rigs as `character`, or unrigged object/morph clips as `animated`; static import/edit reject animation. Learned motion, automatic retarget solvers, retopology, texture rebaking and TRELLIS multiview are not implemented. Inspect actual geometry, animation samples and part previews; ready files, inferred outputs and visually approved results are separate states.
